messages:
rachel_cs: FYI HorizonPark dropped ~88% of inference calls after their SSO cutover. They opened HP-824 and mentioned a competitive proof-of-concept. Need triage + commercial guardrails. :eyes:
ben_csm: I got the ticket. Customer reports intermittent 401s then 502s. Procurement wants a remediation timeline within 48h. I tried the new ML lead (carlos) but no response yet.
akil_solutions: I offered a short troubleshooting session and temporary sandbox keys. They asked for a 1-page SSO failure checklist and a quick demo focused on token refresh behavior. I'll draft both.
jin_eng: From our traces: bursts of auth-exchange failures at 02:28-02:33 UTC -> kvcache-miss -> routing fallback. If they can paste a raw failing request+response we can reproduce. We can also stand up an auth-proxy and a temporary key; engineering ETA ~4-6h after sign-off.
rachel_cs: Customer quote in ticket: "After IDP cutover, our jobs either get 401 or hang until 502. If not resolved we will accelerate competitor eval"
ben_csm: Sales asked about a short bridge offer. Suggestion: 14-day dedicated capacity at no charge + priority eng assistance, contingent on mitigation acknowledgement. No permanent discount. Agree?
akil_solutions: OK with that approach. We'll pair the offer with a checklist and a rollback play (how to re-point tokens). I'll post the checklist draft here once ready.
jin_eng: Action items: 1) Akil request sample request/response from HorizonPark. 2) Jin prepare auth-proxy and test key standby. 3) Ben coordinate procurement/commercial message with sales. 4) Rachel schedule 30-min trouble session with ML lead and include eng + solutions. I'll standby for logs.
alert-bot: Ticket HP-824 updated by rachel_cs at 2025-04-11T10:05Z
rachel_cs: I'll send the invite for 14:00 HorizonPark local and loop exec sponsor. Update thread after accept. :thumbsup:
